title: UpToData
tagline: Let the experts curate & varify your data using DATA DAOs! The experts verify the validity of the storage deals to make sure the data is stored securely and is available for use.
description: Using the Storage Deals, UpToData stores valuable data on IPFS. The relevance of this data is curated and verified by experts who are part of a DAO. The experts verify the validity of the storage deals to make sure the data is stored securely and is available for use. They then verify the authenticity of the data. In turn, UpToData leverages the DATA DAOs to incentivize the experts who are members of a DAO.
how_its_made: On the backend side, we kept three smart contracts. One is our primary contract, which entails all Dao capabilities. The second one is used to input the DAO with all the deal details related to the desired data. We did that by using File coin's MarketAPI and MarketType. The third contract is for our unique coin. All of our contracts were deployed on FevM. In react.js, we developed the front-end.
